_comment: Written by the Security Review persona. The pre-tag CI job reads this to decide whether a release is covered by a current audit. Do not hand-edit.
open_findings: MEDIUM #110: artifact verification (attestation/checksum) appears only in release notes, not in the member-facing install guide
MEDIUM #96: durable audit trail — direction set (B+C), documentation deliverable sequenced after #101
LOW #111: collaboration card interpolates status/priority/token unescaped
notes: Delta review of 0abd1d6 (the #108/#109 fixes) against the 96815ac full review. Scope was two workflow files; no new findings.

CAVEAT — this delta was SELF-REVIEWED: the same session authored the #108/#109 fixes and reviewed them. Recorded so the record does not overstate its own independence. The evidence behind it is mechanical and reproducible rather than judgemental: four gate states exercised against live data (live query, low-only, unprioritised, failed query), edge cases under set -uo pipefail (empty and all-low input both yield 0 without error), and zis-readme-check.yml passing live under the new read-only default.

Verified this review: zis-readme-check.yml declares contents:read and writes nothing; release.yml keeps permissions:{} at workflow scope with security-status ungated and package gated on the release environment; repo settings now default_workflow_permissions=read and can_approve_pull_request_reviews=false.
Mechanical improved 10/2 -> 11/1: the SHA-pinning warning cleared when zis-readme-check.yml was pinned (checkout v4.4.0, setup-python v5.6.0, both held at their existing major versions).

Taxonomy version 2: Category 7 (untrusted content rendering) added after the 96815ac review missed client-side injection. The 96815ac review predates it, so its Category 7 coverage came from an ad-hoc advisor lead rather than the checklist.
NOT re-probed this session: inbound webhook ingress authentication (still relying on the closed #90 disposition); SRI-vs-CDN and environment-reviewer checks are point-in-time from the 96815ac review.
Connect_SDK has had mechanical checks only; no design review has been performed on that repo.
